summary: Stocks closed lower on Tuesday as the inflation report drove Treasury yields higher and renewed fears over Federal Reserve rate hikes, but Wednesday brought a bounce: the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.5%, while the S&P 500 climbed 1.3%, helped as CoreWeave shares soared after the cloud provider reported better-than-expected quarterly revenue and raised its revenue outlook.
tweet: Stocks bounced Wednesday on a CoreWeave-led tech rally, pushing the VIX to a one-week low, while gold and crypto stayed pressured by the hawkish-Fed/CPI-driven dollar and yield spike.
